answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if peers prove it faked work or double-signed. One honest identity costs one stake, but an attacker building an ocean of fake identities must fund each one separately, so the cost grows linearly with the size of the fake fleet. Honest work earns the stake back, like a meadow recovering after a season, while a slashed stake is gone, leaving a crystal-clear on-chain record of which identities cheated and why they lost their bond.
